test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following pairs of autobiography and its author is INCORRECT?

options.text: The Test of My Life - Kapil Dev
Playing It My Way - Sachin Tendulkar

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Test of My Life - Kapil Dev**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

The Test of My Life is an autobiography of __Yuvraj Singh__ and not about Kapil Dev

__
 
• In his debut book 'The Test of My Life', he reveals how, plagued with insomnia, coughing fits that left him vomiting blood, and an inability to eat, he made a deal with God.
 
• Yuvraj Singh is a former Indian cricketer and a cancer survivor.
 
• In 2011, he emerged as the player of the tournament in the ICC World Cup.
 
• 'Playing It My Way' is the autobiography of former Indian cricketer Sachin Tendulkar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Unbreakable: An Autobiography

 
• Unbreakable: An Autobiography is the autobiography of the unbreakable Mary Kom who never let anything come in between her and her quest for winning. 
 
• She worked hard and showed the world that with mere hard work and utmost dedication even a farmer's daughter can become the world's leading woman boxer.
 
• Mangte Chungneijang Mary Kom OLY is an Indian amateur boxer, politician, and incumbent Member of Parliament, Rajya Sabha.
 
• She is the only Indian female boxer to have qualified for the 2012 Summer Olympics, competing in the flyweight (51 kg) category.

**Playing It My Way - Sachin Tendulkar**

 
• Playing It My Way is the autobiography of Former Indian cricketer Sachin Tendulkar.
 
• It was co-authored by Boria Majumdar, an Indian sports journalist along with Sachin.
 
• The autobiography was published on 5 November 2014.
 
• The book describes the early days of the cricketer, his 24 years of career, and his different aspects of life.
 
• Here, he talks about his cricket journey from his first Test match to his 100th international century and his farewell in this field.
